title: CUB severe sparse keypoint missingness and support-isolation diagnostic

selection_mechanisms.MCAR_1: Uniformly choose one image without replacement within every class and fold-training set.
selection_mechanisms.MAR_X_ATYPICAL: Choose the image with minimum within-class frozen-image typicality; availability depends only on observed image X and class Y.
selection_mechanisms.MNAR_Z_INCOMPLETE: Choose the image with minimum hidden keypoint completeness; availability depends on privileged Z that disappears when annotation is absent.
selection_mechanisms.SI_POSE: Choose the maximum normalized head-to-tail horizontal orientation within every class, creating a one-sided pose support hole; missing pose scores are ranked below valid scores.

pose_definition.score: (mean visible head x - tail x) / visible-keypoint horizontal span
pose_definition.fallback: If tail or all head points are absent, pose score is missing and cannot be selected unless all candidates are missing; deterministic image_id tie-break.

screening.training: Use the frozen PAT-D-260728-001 PrPool stack for exactly 9 epochs; classification uses every fold-training image and keypoint BCE uses only the selected one image per class.

primary_endpoints: OOF balanced accuracy relative to stored Global
biased-mechanism delta relative to equal-budget MCAR_1
negative-transfer class rate relative to Global
worst-class recall delta relative to Global
selection manipulation differences in typicality, completeness, and pose

go_no_go.selection_bias_supported_if: At least one of MAR_X_ATYPICAL, MNAR_Z_INCOMPLETE, or SI_POSE is at least 2 pp below MCAR_1 in OOF balanced accuracy, or raises negative-transfer class rate by at least 0.10.
go_no_go.on_go: Repeat this exact severe diagnostic with two additional frozen selection seeds where applicable, then compare correction baselines.
go_no_go.on_no_go: Stop constructing stronger synthetic harm for this PrPool stack. Narrow the research claim toward sparse keypoint annotation selection efficiency/robustness or discontinue H1.
